missionDescription:
The M&A & Integration Specialist – Transactions & Food Manufacturing role is designed for candidates with hands-on transaction experience (investment banking, transaction services, private equity, or corporate development) who are eager to apply their deal skills in a Corporate M&A environment incorporating all aspects of the transaction, Legal, Tax, finance, operation, quality etc….
You will be part of the M&A & Transformation team, reporting directly to the Head of M&A for the Americas, and working closely with North American leadership and Group functions including Operations, R&D, Finance, Procurement, and Commercial teams.
While this role involves full participation in the M&A lifecycle, it is distinct from a traditional finance-only role. A significant portion of your impact will come from understanding manufacturing environments and supporting the integration and performance improvement of acquired food businesses, including time spent on-site.

Key Responsibilities
M&A Transactions 
You will actively contribute to and execute M&A transactions across the food ingredients and food manufacturing space:
•	Support end-to-end M&A processes, including:
o	Financial analysis and valuation
o	Business plan and synergy assessment
o	Identification of key risks during due diligence
•	Participate in and coordinate due diligence processes (financial, operational, commercial)
•	Work closely with external advisors (investment banks, transaction services, legal, tax)
•	Prepare investment memoranda and presentations for Executive Management and Investment Committees
•	Support negotiation of key transaction documents

Post-Merger Integration & Operational Value Creation
Following acquisitions, you will play a key role in post-merger integration and value creation, working closely with operational teams:
•	Contribute to the preparation of detailed integration plans
•	Support execution of integration initiatives across:
o	Manufacturing performance and cost structures
o	Procurement and sourcing synergies
o	Margin, and profitability improvement
o	R&D and product portfolio alignment
•	Analyze operational and financial data to identify performance levers
•	Track integration progress and report key issues to senior management
•	Participate in short- to mid-term on-site assignments at acquired companies

Cross-Functional & Strategic Projects
As part of the M&A & Transformation team, you will also contribute to broader initiatives such as:
•	Strategic analysis 
•	Operational performance improvement projects
•	Cost optimization and procurement synergy initiatives
•	Manufacturing footprint and capacity analysis
•	Group-wide best practice implementation

missionDescription:
Within CACEIS, the General Inspection function is an integral part of the internal control framework. General Inspection is a single business line bringing together teams based in Paris, Ireland, Luxembourg, Munich, Milan, Amsterdam, Kuala Lumpur and Madrid. It conducts periodic control missions within CACEIS. These missions aim to ensure that external and internal rules are complied with, to assess the level of risk management and operational effectiveness of processes within the Bank. General Inspection identifies areas for improvement and issues recommendations for action in the inspection report published at the end of each mission. It then monitors their complete and timely implementation throughout the year.

In this context, the VIE will join the General Inspection team of CACEIS Bank Ireland Branch to carry out Group missions, working with a team junior and experienced staff located internationally (France, Ireland, Luxembourg, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain, Italy, Malaysia).

Your missions
You will be an integral part of the General Inspection team as a VIE and will contribute to missions carried out in Ireland and abroad, under the supervision of a lead inspector.

You will be involved in the entire audit process, from the planning phase through to the issuance of the audit report. In this context, you will be in position to: 
-	Participate and lead initial meetings with auditees to define the scope of work, performing investigation tests in line with internal audit methodologies, drafting documented reports and travels to other CACEIS locations abroad. 
-	Contribute to the preparation of recommendations designed to strengthen the Bank’s internal control framework and to the follow up of these recommendations, ensuring that the risk mitigation measures identified during the missions are fully and timely implemented.
-	Prepare Internal Audit reporting and related documentation for local management and relevant governance committees, supporting clear communication of key findings, risks and recommended actions.
-	Support and lead discussion of the results with both auditees and the managers in a clear and convincing manner.
-	Be part of the continuous audit monitoring process at local level, supporting the General Inspection team

This role provides an opportunity to develop auditing expertise and risk management, through the application of the audit methodology to abroad range of business line and support functions across the bank, fostering specialized knowledge in areas such as asset servicing, IT, or banking regulation.
